_comment: Hand-edited name corrections, keyed by NIS code. These win over OSM and Wikidata. Seeded from the first build's review list in data/REPORT.md.
_rule: Included only where the French form in OSM/Wikidata is a pre-1900 orthographic variant of the same word (gh->g, y->i, c->k, -que->-ke, silent -e) and modern French usage is simply the Dutch spelling, plus two accent restorations on official Walloon spellings. Living French exonyms that are genuinely different words (Anvers, Malines, Gand, Courtrai, Louvain, Ostende, Lierre, Hal, Vilvorde, Schaerbeek, ...) are deliberately NOT overridden. Archaic French *translations* (Vieux-Turnhout, Heist-sur-la-Montagne, Wavre-Sainte-Catherine, ...) are left alone and flagged for review in data/REPORT.md, because calling them dead is a judgement this build cannot verify.
